games.name: Eat Everything In A Grocery Store
games.desc:
The doors are locked. The shelves are full. 4,300,000 calories of food... and you have to eat EVERYTHING.

🍎 CLICK TO EAT: aim, click, chomp! Apples, Choco Puffs, Bloxy Cola, stockroom pallets, even a 150,000-calorie Mega Watermelon. Every item breaks apart bite by bite.
💪 HIT THE GYM: calories are your currency. Spend them at the in-store gym on Hold to Eat, Speed, Multi Eat (up to x12!), Calories and Reach.
👥 SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS: start a party in the lobby. Same store, more mouths: clear it faster together!
📖 FOOD INDEX: taste all 175 foods to complete your collection. Can you find the hidden golden banana?
💰 $1,000,000 PRIZE: empty the store and split the million (in-game cash) with your team.
🏆 LEADERBOARDS: most calories eaten and fastest store cleared.

The real-life challenge took 113 days. How fast can YOU clear it?
